title: •Gold 1
caption: •Gold 1 (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots or passengers. If Dutch piloting, power +2, immune to attrition < 4, and once during any control phase, may take the top or bottom card of your Force Pile into hand.
lore: Lead fighter of Gold Squadron at Battle of Yavin. Flown by Jon ‘Dutch’ Vander. Designated Specter 1 at Renforra Base.
